# SD18 deterministic Human Paladin level 14 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 level-13 fixture
# (tests/sd18_paladin_level13_widening.rs) to level 14 as chosen input
# only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic Longsword / Chain
# Shirt / no-shield / Power Attack posture, and the level-3..level-13
# fixture's mercy selections unchanged (choice:paladin_mercy ->
# mercy:shaken, choice:paladin_mercy_4 -> mercy:blinded).
#
# The PF1 CRB Paladin class table's level-14 "Special" column reads
# "Aura of faith" ONLY (verified independently against d20pfsrd, the
# Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror, and legacy.aonprd.com, all three
# agreeing byte-for-byte) -- a genuinely NEW class feature, grounded as a
# bounded grant-only identity record, mirroring the Aura of Justice /
# Monk Diamond Body idiom exactly: no good-alignment-weapon-treatment
# execution engine and no damage-reduction-overcoming resolution engine
# exists anywhere in this codebase. 14th is NOT a repeat-Mercy-grant
# level (the 3rd/6th/9th/12th/15th cadence), so no fifth mercy selection
# is added here. The base spells-per-day table's level-14 row is
# "3/2/1/1" (verified independently against all three sources): the
# 1st/2nd/3rd-level columns stay 3/2/1 unchanged, and the 4th-level
# column genuinely rises from 0 to 1 -- the first castable 4th-level
# paladin spell slot.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later hybrid burden surface: no spell
# selections, no spells known/prepared posture, no domains, no mercy
# EFFECT resolution, no channel positive energy healing/damage-resolution
# execution, no Divine Bond (weapon bond / mount bond) selection or
# execution, no Aura of Justice's own smite-sharing resolution, no Aura
# of Faith's own good-alignment-weapon-treatment resolution, and no
# level-15+ progression.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-paladin-level14
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:paladin:14
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:diplomacy:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
choice=choice:paladin_mercy:mercy:shaken
choice=choice:paladin_mercy_4:mercy:blinded
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
